name: Apollo iOS
description: A GraphQL client for iOS that returns results as query-specific Swift types, and integrates with Xcode to show your Swift source and GraphQL side by side, with inline validation errors.

capabilities.note: There is no server capability so far that could justify adding support in Apollo Client

directives-on-directives.note: Provided by [GraphQL.js](../project/graphql-js) 17.0.1, bundled since Apollo iOS 2.2.0 ([pr](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-ios-dev/pull/1033))

executable-documents-descriptions.note: Descriptions are parsed by [GraphQL.js](../project/graphql-js) 17.0.0-alpha.11 and later, but Apollo iOS does not use them in the generated code

fragment-arguments.note: [GraphQL.js](../project/graphql-js) can parse fragment arguments with `experimentalFragmentArguments`, but Apollo iOS does not turn this option on

persisted-documents.note: The protocol for persisted documents is still TBD
